_comment: Recorded SX orders for one market (ARB_LADDER_SPEC §0 calibration). taker cost = 1 - percentageOdds/1e20 over maker orders on the opposite side; a maker with remaining stake M (USDC*1e6) at cost c backs taker notional T = M*c/(1-c). contracts = T/c = M/(1-c). Orders here are isMakerBettingOutcomeOne=false, so the taker takes outcome one.
